# Pixenox

> PIXENOX SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN: U62091AP2026PTC125091) is an India-based AI systems and enterprise software engineering company building production multi-agent AI systems, non-disruptive enterprise intelligence platforms, AI visibility (GEO/AEO) infrastructure, and proprietary software products including Engenox and Unool.

Every HTML page listed below also serves a clean Markdown twin via `.md` suffix or `Accept: text/markdown` HTTP content negotiation, with `X-Markdown-Tokens` estimates and `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes`.

([HTML](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility))

([HTML](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering))

## Proprietary Products & Open Engineering Tools
- [Engenox by Pixenox](https://www.pixenox.com/products/engenox.md): Unified autonomous SEO, GEO, and AEO operating system for crawl governance, entity graphs, Markdown transport, and AI citation intelligence. ([HTML](https://www.pixenox.com/products/engenox))
- [Free AI Visibility & GEO Checker](https://www.pixenox.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker.md): Live technical diagnostic scoring any public domain across SSR text availability, AI bot governance, Schema.org `@graph`, `llms.txt`, `Content-Signal`, and `Accept: text/markdown`. ([HTML](https://www.pixenox.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker))
- [Enterprise AI, GEO & AEO Glossary](https://www.pixenox.com/glossary.md): Canonical engineering definitions for 20 core AI systems, GEO, AEO, and data infrastructure concepts. ([HTML](https://www.pixenox.com/glossary))
- [Unool](https://unool.co): One Link + One Click social publishing and creator distribution platform built by Pixenox Solutions.
